svg.metadata: {"title":"Bank clone: before and after #6666","speed":2000,"elements":[{"id":"root","type":"group","children":["src","worker","dst"],"layout":{"direction":"row","gap":56,"align":"center"}},{"id":"src","type":"cylinder","content":[{"type":"title","text":"Source bank"},{"type":"subtitle","text":"215k memories"}]},{"id":"worker","type":"group","label":{"title":"Clone task (worker)"},"children":["read","archive"],"layout":{"direction":"column","gap":28,"align":"stretch"}},{"id":"read","type":"rectangle","content":[{"type":"title","text":"Read the bank"}]},{"id":"archive","type":"rectangle","content":[{"type":"title","text":"Archive"}]},{"id":"dst","type":"cylinder","content":[{"type":"title","text":"New bank"}]},{"id":"pull","type":"arrow","route":"curved","start":{"id":"src"},"end":{"id":"read"},"label":{"text":"SQL reads"}},{"id":"build","type":"arrow","route":"curved","start":{"id":"read"},"end":{"id":"archive"}},{"id":"restore","type":"arrow","route":"curved","start":{"id":"archive"},"end":{"id":"dst"},"label":{"text":"restore"}}],"scenes":[{"label":"Before","beats":[{"edges":{"edge":"pull","data":"one transaction"},"light":["read"],"show":{"read":[{"tag":"conn","tone":"orange","text":"1 connection, open ~40 min"}]},"say":"The whole bank was read inside one open transaction."},{"light":["read"],"ms":2600,"show":{"read":[{"tag":"conn","tone":"red","text":"closed by the pooler","mark":"✗"}]},"say":"A pooler with a connection-lifetime limit cut it. The clone failed, and every retry did the same."},{"edges":"build","show":{"archive":[{"tag":"RAM","tone":"orange","text":"whole archive in memory"}]},"say":"When it did finish, the archive was built in memory before the restore."}]},{"label":"After","beats":[{"edges":{"edge":"pull","data":"short reads"},"show":{"read":[{"tag":"conn","tone":"green","text":"a pooled connection per read","mark":"✓"}]},"say":"The clone reads like an export: many short reads, each on its own connection."},{"edges":"build","show":{"archive":[{"tag":"disk","tone":"blue","text":"streamed to a temp file"}]},"say":"The archive is streamed into a local temp file, not held in memory."},{"edges":"restore","ms":2600,"show":{"dst":[{"text":"restored from the file","mark":"new"}]},"say":"The restore reads it back entry by entry. Nothing stays open long enough to be cut."}]}]}
